arguments.prompt:
Create one standalone logo proposal screen for the personal brand “Jovina Diniz”.

This screen must contain ONLY one logo concept for review.

**LOGO DIRECTION:** Sophisticated stacked typographic lockup.
Create an elegant typographic logo where “Jovina Diniz” has a distinctive hierarchy, spacing and custom detail. Integrate one subtle linear signature element derived from the initials without turning it into an illustration. Include “Terapeuta Integrativa & Mentora de Mulheres” below.

**PRESENTATION:** Show one large stacked lockup and one compact horizontal version. Label it “Opção 07”.

Avoid generic therapy/coaching icons and all banned motifs: lotus, butterfly, brain, heart, hands, female silhouette, tree, moon, mandala, leaf, infinity, medical cross.
